capacity: the maximum amount that can be held or produced
The tank has a capacity of ten litres.
She has a great capacity for work.
cause: a person or thing that makes something happen
Poor drainage was the cause of the flood.
challenge: a difficult task that tests ability
The exam was a real challenge.
question whether something is right or true
change: The change in weather was sudden.
claim: state that something is true, usually without proof
She claims to have solved it.
a statement that something is true
clear: easy to see through or understand
remove what is in the way
Clear the desk before the test.
compare: examine the likenesses and differences of
complex: a whole made of related parts
A sports complex opened last year.
concept: The concept of gravity changed physics.
conclude: We concluded that the sample was too small.
consequence: a result or effect of an action
context: the circumstances that give something its meaning
contrast: a difference that is clear when things are compared
The contrast between the two colors is strong.
critical: expressing careful judgment of good and bad points
A critical reading of the text.
of great importance to the outcome
It is critical to save your work.
